diet-plan-description: Set calorie and macro targets, cooking days and meals per day, then generate a batch-cooking plan from your recipes.
persons-description: Everyone you cook for, with their daily targets.
name: Name
macro-summary: Protein {protein}% · Fat {fat}% · Carbs {carbs}% · macros give {kcal} kcal
cooking-days-description: On a cooking day you cook for every day until the next cooking day.
meals-per-day-description: How many meals a day and what share of the daily calories each one gets.
no-persons: Add at least one person in Settings first.
saved-to-calendar: Saved {created} meals to the meal planner
warning-no-candidates: No recipes for {meal} with calories filled in – import some recipes.
warning-few-candidates: Only {count} recipe(s) for {meal} – dishes will repeat.
import-from-files-description: Upload recipe files (.md) or a .zip with them. Each file is one recipe with ready calories and macros. Importing a file with the same name again updates the recipe.
scan-hint: Point the camera at the barcode on the package.
camera-unavailable: Couldn't start the camera – type the code instead.
search-hint: Type a name – searching your products and Open Food Facts
off-unavailable: Open Food Facts isn't responding – try again in a minute or add the product by hand.
off-nothing: Nothing found in Open Food Facts.
barcode-not-found: Unknown barcode – add the product by hand, the code is filled in.
counter-description: Log what you eat: products, recipes, freezer portions or quick entries.
nothing-from-plan: Nothing new from the plan for this day.
my-products-hint: Products added by hand and saved from Open Food Facts. Values per 100 g or 100 ml.
changes-description: What you added, used less of or swapped – the macros are recalculated.
molds-description: How many molds of which size you split the dish into. Macros are split by capacity.
freezer-description: Portions cooked ahead: how many molds are left and their calories.
delete-batch-confirm: Delete this batch from the freezer?
eat-same-day: I eat from the cooking day
eat-next-day: I eat from the next day (e.g. cooking in the evening)
shopping-list-description: Saving the plan creates a shopping list with amounts for the servings to cook.
shopping-list-period: One list for the whole plan
saved-with-lists: Saved {created} meals to the meal planner and created shopping lists: {lists}
scanner-failed: The scanner doesn't work in this browser – type the code instead.
recipe-ingredients-hint: Click an ingredient you left out, used less of or swapped:
from-recipe-less: From the recipe: {text} – enter how many grams less
